1.name: Grass Shrimp

zones.label: Delaware tidal waters
zones.bagNote: No limit — not a regulated species

notes: Not listed in Delaware's tidal seasons, size and creel limits: no minimum size, daily limit or closed season applies to recreational harvest. General gear rules (cast nets, dip nets, minnow traps) and a fishing license still apply.

3.name: Knobbed Whelk

zones.label: Delaware tidal waters
zones.sizeNote: 5 inches along the axis, or 3.0 inch whorl diameter

notes: Pots must carry all-white buoys with the owner's name and address and be tended at least every 72 hours.
